> 第六章 紫茉 二（第1页）
“你舍不得也留不住了，找个合适的人嫁了吧！”皇甫陌轩冷冷的开口。
“为什么？总要有个理由吧？”蓝若晴急急的问道。
“没有理由！”皇甫陌轩极其愤怒，站起来大声的说道，“嫁了人，总比留在我府中，有一天做出了丢人现眼的事要好的多！我可不希望你的婢女，污了我府中的风气！哼！”说完，皇甫陌轩拂袖就要离开。
“等等！”蓝若晴拉住皇甫陌轩的衣袖，“你把话说清楚，什么叫做出了丢人现眼的事？什么叫污了你府中的风气？”
“你自己去问你那好丫头吧！若不是被我撞见她与栓子两人苟合在一起，我还真会相信她是清清白白的！”说完，皇甫陌轩没有理会蓝若晴的惊讶，转身离开！
“怎么会？怎么会……”蓝若晴跌坐在凳子上，呆愣的望着油灯，无法相信这一事实。
紫茉悄悄的走进来，轻轻的掩上房门。
“紫茉，你过来！”听到紫茉走进来，蓝若晴怒道。
紫茉走过来，“啪！”一个清脆的耳光打在紫茉的脸上。
紫茉扑通一声跪在若晴面前，哭着说：“小姐，我知道你现在生气，你打吧，打够了，就不生气了。”
听到紫茉如是说，蓝若晴反而熄灭了所有的怒气，抱住紫茉哭着说，“紫茉，你怎么可以这样？你喜欢哪个人，告诉我啊，虽然我舍不得你嫁，可是我也不能耽误了你的终身幸福！你怎么可以这样自作主张的跑去与人私会？你喜欢栓子，我可以成全你，也不必这样偷偷摸摸的，被人抓住了，就更是无法说清楚了。现如今，我想保你也难啊！”
“不！不！不！”紫茉的头摇的像拨浪鼓，“不是的，小姐，不是这样的！我不知道王爷是怎样和你说的，但是事实不是那样的。紫茉不要嫁人，紫茉还要服待小姐一辈子呢！小姐，我知道王爷待你极好，你的心中也只有王爷。可是有件事，紫茉还是要和你说。”
原来，刚刚紫茉去给蓝若晴取酸梅汤，还没进厨房就听到里面两个嬷嬷对话。
其中一个嬷嬷说：“王妃这么好的女人，王爷怎么不知珍惜，却和那样一个女人私会。王妃为了等候王爷回来都没吃晚饭，可是王爷却带了那么妖艳的一个女人回来，听说还是王妃的妹妹呢！唉，你说，这同是姐妹，怎么会那么不同？一个端庄秀丽，一个狐媚妖艳。王爷对王妃不闻不问的，这不与王妃共进晚餐也就算了，还吩咐人把饭菜送到客房。刚刚我听玲儿那丫头说，她进去时那女人几乎是整个人挂在王爷身上的，衣衫不整，胸衣都暴露在外。你说，这样子一个不知检点的女人，怎能和咱们的王妃比？”
只听得另外一个嬷嬷说：“是啊！这种女人也就是靠狐媚功勾搭男人，等王爷厌了，倦了，就会想起咱王妃的好了对不？王妃那才是大家闺秀，贤良淑德呢！这王爷呀……”

> Chapter 6 Purple Mo 2 (Page 1)
"If you can't bear it or keep it, find a suitable person to marry!" Huangfu Moxuan said coldly.
"Why? There has to be a reason, right?" Lan Ruoqing asked anxiously.
"There is no reason!" Huangfu Moxuan was extremely angry and stood up and said loudly, "It is much better to get married than to stay in my house and do something embarrassing one day! I don't want your maid to pollute the atmosphere of my house! Humph!" After saying that, Huangfu Moxuan rolled his sleeves and was about to leave.
"Wait!" Lan Ruoqing grabbed Huangfu Moxuan's sleeve, "Please tell me clearly, what does it mean to have something embarrassing happen? What does it mean to pollute the atmosphere of your house?"
"Go and ask your good girl yourself! If I hadn't caught her and Shuanzi having sex together, I would have really believed that she was innocent!" After saying that, Huangfu Moxuan ignored Lan Ruoqing's surprise and turned to leave!
"How could it be? How could it be..." Lan Ruoqing fell down on the stool and stared blankly at the oil lamp, unable to believe this fact.
Zi Mo walked in quietly and closed the door gently.
"Zimo, come here!" Lan Ruoqing said angrily when she heard Zimo walking in.
Zi Mo came over and said, "Pah!" A crisp slap hit Zi Mo's face.
Zimo plopped down and knelt down in front of Ruoqing, crying: "Miss, I know you are angry now, so go ahead and beat her. After you beat her enough, you won't be angry anymore."
Hearing what Zimo said, Lan Ruoqing extinguished all her anger, hugged Zimo and cried, "Zimo, how could you do this? Tell me who you like. Although I am reluctant to marry you, I can't delay your end." You are so happy! How can you go and have a private meeting like this? If you like Shuanzi, you don't have to be so secretive. Now, it's even harder for me to protect you!"
"No! No! No!" Zi Mo shook her head like a rattle, "No, miss, it's not like that! I don't know what the prince told you, but the fact is not like that. Zi Mo doesn't want to get married, Zi Mo has to serve the lady for the rest of his life! Miss, I know that the prince treats you very well, and you only have the prince in your heart. But there is something that Zi Mo still wants to tell you."
It turned out that Zimo had just gone to get sour plum soup for Lan Ruoqing, and before she even entered the kitchen, she heard the conversation between the two nuns inside.
One of the nuns said: "How could the prince not cherish such a good woman like the princess, but have a private meeting with such a woman? The princess didn't even have dinner in order to wait for the prince to come back, but the prince brought back such a charming woman. I heard that she is the princess's sister! Oh, tell me, they are both sisters, how can they be so different? One is dignified and beautiful, and the other is foxy. She is so charming and indifferent to the princess, even if she doesn’t have dinner with her, she even ordered the food to be delivered to the guest room. Just now, I heard the girl Ling’er said that when she came in, the woman was almost naked, her clothes were disheveled, and her bra was exposed. How can such an ignorant woman compare with our princess? "
I heard another nun say: "Yes! This kind of woman relies on her charming skills to seduce men. When the prince gets tired of it, she will think of our princess, right? The princess is the lady of the world, virtuous and virtuous! This prince..."
